name: instagram-unfollowers-extension
description: Chrome extension to see who doesn't follow you back on Instagram
author: Jonathan Gan

scripts.build: npm run clean && webpack --mode production && cp src/popup/index.html dist/popup.html && cp manifest.json dist/manifest.json && cp -r public/icons dist/icons
scripts.package: npm run build && VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") && cd dist && zip -r ../instagram-unfollowers-v$VERSION.zip .
